mapper.select: SELECT rcp_seq,rcp_nm,rcp_pat2,info_eng,user_id,att_file_no_main,hit,hash_tag,users.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE recipe_like.recipe_id = recipe.rcp_seq) AS like_count FROM recipe JOIN users ON recipe.user_id = users.id ORDER BY rcp_seq DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT rcp_seq,rcp_nm,rcp_pat2,info_eng,user_id,att_file_no_main,hit,hash_tag,users.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE recipe_like.recipe_id = recipe.rcp_seq) AS like_count FROM recipe JOIN users ON recipe.user_id = users.id WHERE rcp_pat2 = #{main_category} ORDER BY rcp_seq DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/12.0) FROM recipe WHERE rcp_pat2 = #{main_category}
